name: pod-frame
description: Pod Frame video-editing style for Claude: Podcast edit: auto camera switching by who is talking, name cards, quote pulls and a live audio bar. Use for video podcasts and interviews with 2-4 cameras (or one wide shot). Turns a raw clip into a finished 16:9 edit with the video-studio-core engine (transcribe, auto-cut, motion graphics, sound, grade).

findings.excerpt: python CORE/scripts/run.py clip.mp4 --style STYLE --work edit-pod-frame --stop-after plan --title "SHOW NAME"
